posts.name: Nepycros
posts.cooked: When I discussed the 'most complicated turn' possible for Sentinels with one of the other regulars on Twitch, I brought up Argent Adept, Grandpa Legacy, and Guise. It's nice to know that less than a week later, I get to test that out against the resident punching bag. My only grief with it is that the game can end too quickly, and I've only pulled off 7 or so inexplicably long chains of card interactions (like Argent using a power to gain a power, to give Guise a power to use a card to gain Legacy's power to give Legacy a power to give Argent a power to give Guise 3 card plays so that Guise can then use Argent's power to draw/play cards, so that he can deal upwards of 30 damage in a nonsensical burst) before all the relics mysteriously end up in the trash either by well-timed Jumping the Sharks or some other shenanigans involving Argent blowing up an Instrument for a low-loss kill.

posts.name: Fynikz
posts.cooked:
I got Santa Guise during this, I'm not sure EXACTLY what the conditions were. I had:

Legacy with Fortitude, Next Evolution, and Inspiring Presence.

Guise who had played Guise the Barbarian, Super Ultra Kawaii, and used Super Ultra Kawaii to play Selling Out! (yes, all of the card plays)

During Selling Out (One-shots), I used Gimmicky Character for an extra card play of any type and played "Uh, yeah, I'm that guy!" on Legacy before chaining Best Card Ever!s together. I'm not sure exactly when Santa Guise unlocked during that.

 

Given the text for the one-shot involves Guise specifically calling out grandpa Legacy and "THAT card", I imagune "Uh, yeah, I'm that guy!" on Legacy is a big part of it. Probably with either Inspiring Presence (Inspiring PRESENTS?) and/or Next Evolution (because Santa Guise in the next evolution of Guise.. harhar?)
